summary: After an identity move, every check and screen uses the identity each part really runs as.

fixes.title: Setup checks follow the moved identity
fixes.text: Every setup check, fix command and grant uses the identity each app or job signs in as, and re-running setup keeps it. No right is removed.

fixes.title: Screens name each job clearly
fixes.text: Screens show each job as its role, its real name and the identity it runs as.
